patterns.plausible_wrong_implementation: Implement an open-ended rejection class as a finite list of known bad descriptors so the named examples pass while novel descriptors are accepted.

sibling_cases.evidence: copo azul and tigela nova are rejected by structure rather than descriptor enumeration.
pote translucido, copo rachado and tigela brilhante are rejected although the discriminants are absent from implementation enums.
copo de acai, prato com arroz and pote de iogurte remain accepted when the suffix carries a known local food signal.

prevention_change.evidence: Product cleanup now uses structural/container-content rules; prevention skill requires novel discriminants for open-set negative classes. See evidence/open-set-negative.txt and evidence/skill-remediation.txt.

detection_change.evidence: Audit control design now requires attacking candidate finite enumerations with discriminants absent from those lists and sibling surfaces. See evidence/skill-remediation.txt.
